description: Late check-in: acceptance of passengers after the deadline
Boarding: discrepancies and paging; missing checked-in passengers
Baggage processing: sorting or loading error
Aircraft documentation late or inaccurate
Loading or unloading: bulky or special load
Servicing equipment: lack of staff or equipment
Fuelling or defuelling: late delivery
Aircraft defects: technical fault found at or before departure
Scheduled maintenance: late release from planned work
Aircraft change for technical reasons
Flight plan: late completion or change of flight documentation
Late crew boarding or departure procedures: cockpit crew
Flight deck crew shortage: sickness or awaiting standby
Flight deck crew special request not within operational requirements
Departure station weather below operating limits
Enroute or alternate weather requiring extra fuel or rerouting
De-icing of aircraft: removal of ice or snow
ATFM due to ATC enroute demand or capacity
ATFM due to restriction at destination airport
Aircraft rotation: late arrival of aircraft from another flight
Cabin crew rotation: awaiting crew from another flight
Crew rotation: awaiting flight deck crew from another flight
